title: DualOS GBL SD-only Android boot rebuild after DevicePathText fix
command:
cd "$HOME/source/DualOS-tools/aosp-uefi-gbl/bootable/libbootloader" || exit 2
printf "\n=== SOURCE CHECK ===\n"
grep -n -A 2 "let selected_disk_path" gbl/efi/src/efi_blocks.rs
git diff --check
printf "\n=== AARCH64 EFI BUILD ===\n"
./gbl/bazel.sh build \
  --extra_toolchains=@gbl//toolchain:all \
  @gbl//efi:aarch64_dev

git.status:
M gbl/efi/src/efi_blocks.rs
 M gbl/efi/src/lib.rs
 M gbl/libefi/src/lib.rs
 M gbl/libefi/src/protocol/device_path.rs
 M gbl/libefi/src/protocol/simple_text_output.rs
?? gbl/efi/src/diagnostic_fs.rs
